name: AHI Rest API POST - V2.0.0
info:
## This node send single message to AHI Rest API Broker (AM). ### Input `Endpoint`:Rest API Broker endpoint
### Output1 output1 will trigger when data send success,
`msg.info` = "sent."
`msg.payload` = [msg] (send message) ### Output2 output2 will trigger when data send fail/no input msg
`msg` is empty if send fail
`msg` is "Send fail or message empty!" if send fail or empty input
### Note 1. Node input `msg.payload` must be an array.
`example`: [data1,data2,data3,data4]. 2. Msg will only sent if input `msg.payload` array length is greather than or equal to 1. 3. Msg will be sending at end of the input array `msg.payload`.

name: post-rest-api
Buffer -AM v2 (3)
info:
## This node buffers data in array format. Input will be added at the beginning of the buffer array. ### Input `buffer_size`: Defines maximum buffer size.If max buffer reached,last element from the buffer will be removed.
### Topics If `msg.topic` == "add",
Given `msg.payload` will be added to the buffer array.
If `msg.topic` == "remove",
Input `msg.payload` will be removed from the buffer array. `msg.payload` must be an array
If `msg.topic` == "clear",
Clears all data from the buffer array. ### Output 1 Output Trigger when msg.topic = add or remove or clear & inject once at start `msg.payload` = [msg1,msg2,msg3...]
